card.name: Punctuation in web citations and links
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and link text at seams in web pages, such as after a URL, in a citation, or in a source credit. It fires at the point where a reference or heading block begins or ends.

modes.label: URL and link edges
modes.description: Fires on the dot or colon around web addresses and reference lists.

modes.label: Citation and credit punctuation
modes.description: Fires on closing marks in source credits, titles and bracketed link labels.
